channel.title: Read Mandarin
channel.description: Learn Mandarin Chinese with free HSK-graded short readings. Every text comes with pinyin, tap-to-translate words, audio and English translation.

item.title: 敦煌的守护者 — The Guardians of Dunhuang (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 188 words. 敦煌莫高窟位于中国西北的戈壁边缘，七百余个洞窟里保存着一千多年的壁画与彩塑。 — The Guardians of Dunhuang. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 生物多样性 — Biodiversity (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 188 words. 提到保护生物多样性，人们最先想到的往往是大熊猫、老虎这类形象鲜明的动物。 — Biodiversity. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 气候变化与责任 — Climate Change and Responsibility (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 177 words. 关于气候变化，公众最常听到的建议是随手关灯、少用塑料袋、尽量乘坐公共交通。 — Climate Change and Responsibility. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 科幻的黄金时代 — A Golden Age of Sci-Fi (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 181 words. 每隔一段时间，总有人宣称科幻的黄金时代已经过去。 — A Golden Age of Sci-Fi. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 博物馆热 — The Museum Boom (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 182 words. 近几年，博物馆忽然成了年轻人最热衷的去处，一到假期，热门展馆的门票往往在开放预约的几分钟内被抢光。 — The Museum Boom. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 马拉松热 — The Marathon Craze (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 187 words. 最近几年，国内的马拉松比赛越来越多，报名的人常常是名额的十几倍。 — The Marathon Craze. Pinyin, audio and English included.
